lines.gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੀ ਮੇਰੀ ਕੈਰਉ ਕਰਤੇ ਦੁਰਜੋਧਨ ਸੇ ਭਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: meree meree kairau karate durajodhan se bhaaee ||
lines.translation: The Kaurvas, who had brothers like Duryodhan, used to proclaim, "This is ours! This is ours!"

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਾਰਹ ਜੋਜਨ ਛਤ੍ਰੁ ਚਲੈ ਥਾ ਦੇਹੀ ਗਿਰਝਨ ਖਾਈ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: baarah jojan chhatr chalai thaa dehee girajhan khaaee ||2||
lines.translation: Their royal procession extended over sixty miles, and yet their bodies were eaten by vultures. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਰਬ ਸੋੁਇਨ ਕੀ ਲੰਕਾ ਹੋਤੀ ਰਾਵਨ ਸੇ ਅਧਿਕਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: sarab souin kee la(n)kaa hotee raavan se adhikaaee ||
lines.translation: Sri Lanka was totally rich with gold; was anyone greater than its ruler Raavan?

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹਾ ਭਇਓ ਦਰਿ ਬਾਂਧੇ ਹਾਥੀ ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਭਈ ਪਰਾਈ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: kahaa bhaio dar baa(n)dhe haathee khin mahi bhaee paraaee ||3||
lines.translation: What happened to the elephants, tethered at his gate? In an instant, it all belonged to someone else. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੁਰਬਾਸਾ ਸਿਉ ਕਰਤ ਠਗਉਰੀ ਜਾਦਵ ਏ ਫਲ ਪਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: durabaasaa siu karat thagauree jaadav e phal paae ||
lines.translation: The Yaadvas deceived Durbaasaa, and received their rewards.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੀ ਜਨ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਊਪਰ ਨਾਮਦੇਉ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਏ ॥੪॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: kripaa karee jan apune oopar naamadeu har gun gaae ||4||1||
lines.translation: The Lord has shown mercy to His humble servant, and now Naam Dayv sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||4||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਦਸ ਬੈਰਾਗਨਿ ਮੋਹਿ ਬਸਿ ਕੀਨੑੀ ਪੰਚਹੁ ਕਾ ਮਿਟ ਨਾਵਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: das bairaagan mohi bas keenhee pa(n)chahu kaa mit naavau ||
lines.translation: I have brought the ten sensory organs under my control, and erased every trace of the five thieves.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਰਿ ਦੋਇ ਭਰੇ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਸਰਿ ਬਿਖੁ ਕਉ ਮਾਰਿ ਕਢਾਵਉ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: satar doi bhare a(n)mrit sar bikh kau maar kadhaavau ||1||
lines.translation: I have filled the seventy-two thousand nerve channels with Ambrosial Nectar, and drained out the poison. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਾਛੈ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਨ ਆਵਨੁ ਪਾਵਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: paachhai bahur na aavan paavau ||
lines.translation: I shall not come into the world again.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਾਣੀ ਘਟ ਤੇ ਉਚਰਉ ਆਤਮ ਕਉ ਸਮਝਾਵਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)mrit baanee ghat te ucharau aatam kau samajhaavau ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: I chant the Ambrosial Bani of the Word from the depths of my heart, and I have instructed my soul. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਜਰ ਕੁਠਾਰੁ ਮੋਹਿ ਹੈ ਛੀਨਾਂ ਕਰਿ ਮਿੰਨਤਿ ਲਗਿ ਪਾਵਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: bajar kuthaar mohi hai chheenaa(n) kar mi(n)nat lag paavau ||
lines.translation: I fell at the Guru's feet and begged of Him; with the mighty axe, I have chopped off emotional attachment.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੰਤਨ ਕੇ ਹਮ ਉਲਟੇ ਸੇਵਕ ਭਗਤਨ ਤੇ ਡਰਪਾਵਉ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: sa(n)tan ke ham ulate sevak bhagatan te darapaavau ||2||
lines.translation: Turning away from the world, I have become the servant of the Saints; I fear no one except the Lord's devotees. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਹ ਸੰਸਾਰ ਤੇ ਤਬ ਹੀ ਛੂਟਉ ਜਉ ਮਾਇਆ ਨਹ ਲਪਟਾਵਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: ih sa(n)saar te tab hee chhootau jau maaiaa nah lapataavau ||
lines.translation: I shall be released from this world, when I stop clinging to Maya.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਨਾਮੁ ਗਰਭ ਜੋਨਿ ਕਾ ਤਿਹ ਤਜਿ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਪਾਵਉ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: maaiaa naam garabh jon kaa tih taj darasan paavau ||3||
lines.translation: Maya is the name of the power which causes us to be born; renouncing it, we obtain the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਤੁ ਕਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਜੋ ਜਨ ਤਿਨ ਭਉ ਸਗਲ ਚੁਕਾਈਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: it kar bhagat karahi jo jan tin bhau sagal chukaaeeai ||
lines.translation: That humble being, who performs devotional worship in this way, is rid of all fear.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹਤ ਨਾਮਦੇਉ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਕਿਆ ਭਰਮਹੁ ਇਹ ਸੰਜਮ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਈਐ ॥੪॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: kahat naamadeu baahar kiaa bharamahu ih sa(n)jam har paaeeai ||4||2||
lines.translation: Says Naam Dayv, why are you wandering around out there? This is the way to find the Lord. ||4||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਰਵਾੜਿ ਜੈਸੇ ਨੀਰੁ ਬਾਲਹਾ ਬੇਲਿ ਬਾਲਹਾ ਕਰਹਲਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: maaravaaR jaise neer baalahaa bel baalahaa karahalaa ||
lines.translation: As water is very precious in the desert, and the creeper weeds are dear to the camel,

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਕੁਰੰਕ ਨਿਸਿ ਨਾਦੁ ਬਾਲਹਾ ਤਿਉ ਮੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਰਾਮਈਆ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: jiu kura(n)k nis naad baalahaa tiu merai man raamaeeaa ||1||
lines.translation: and the tune of the hunter's bell at night is enticing to the deer, so is the Lord to my mind. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੇਰਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਰੂੜੋ ਰੂਪੁ ਰੂੜੋ ਅਤਿ ਰੰਗ ਰੂੜੋ ਮੇਰੋ ਰਾਮਈਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: teraa naam rooRo roop rooRo at ra(n)g rooRo mero raamaeeaa ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Your Name is so beautiful! Your form is so beautiful! Your Love is so very beautiful, O my Lord. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਧਰਣੀ ਕਉ ਇੰਦ੍ਰੁ ਬਾਲਹਾ ਕੁਸਮ ਬਾਸੁ ਜੈਸੇ ਭਵਰਲਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: jiu dharanee kau i(n)dr baalahaa kusam baas jaise bhavaralaa ||
lines.translation: As rain is dear to the earth, and the flower's fragrance is dear to the bumble bee,

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਕੋਕਿਲ ਕਉ ਅੰਬੁ ਬਾਲਹਾ ਤਿਉ ਮੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਰਾਮਈਆ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: jiu kokil kau a(n)b baalahaa tiu merai man raamaeeaa ||2||
lines.translation: and the mango is dear to the cuckoo, so is the Lord to my mind. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਚਕਵੀ ਕਉ ਜੈਸੇ ਸੂਰੁ ਬਾਲਹਾ ਮਾਨ ਸਰੋਵਰ ਹੰਸੁਲਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: chakavee kau jaise soor baalahaa maan sarovar ha(n)sulaa ||
lines.translation: As the sun is dear to the chakvi duck, and the lake of Man Sarovar is dear to the swan,

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਤਰੁਣੀ ਕਉ ਕੰਤੁ ਬਾਲਹਾ ਤਿਉ ਮੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਰਾਮਈਆ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: jiu tarunee kau ka(n)t baalahaa tiu merai man raamaeeaa ||3||
lines.translation: and the husband is dear to his wife, so is the Lord to my mind. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਾਰਿਕ ਕਉ ਜੈਸੇ ਖੀਰੁ ਬਾਲਹਾ ਚਾਤ੍ਰਿਕ ਮੁਖ ਜੈਸੇ ਜਲਧਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: baarik kau jaise kheer baalahaa chaatrik mukh jaise jaladharaa ||
lines.translation: As milk is dear to the baby, and the raindrop is dear to the mouth of the rainbird,

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਛੁਲੀ ਕਉ ਜੈਸੇ ਨੀਰੁ ਬਾਲਹਾ ਤਿਉ ਮੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਰਾਮਈਆ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: machhulee kau jaise neer baalahaa tiu merai man raamaeeaa ||4||
lines.translation: and as water is dear to the fish, so is the Lord to my mind. ||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਿਕ ਸਿਧ ਸਗਲ ਮੁਨਿ ਚਾਹਹਿ ਬਿਰਲੇ ਕਾਹੂ ਡੀਠੁਲਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: saadhik sidh sagal mun chaahahi birale kaahoo deethulaa ||
lines.translation: All the seekers, Siddhas and silent sages seek Him, but only a rare few behold Him.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਗਲ ਭਵਣ ਤੇਰੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਬਾਲਹਾ ਤਿਉ ਨਾਮੇ ਮਨਿ ਬੀਠੁਲਾ ॥੫॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: sagal bhavan tero naam baalahaa tiu naame man beethulaa ||5||3||
lines.translation: Just as Your Name is dear to all the Universe, so is the Lord dear to Naam Dayv's mind. ||5||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਹਿਲ ਪੁਰੀਏ ਪੁੰਡਰਕ ਵਨਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: pahil pureee pu(n)darak vanaa ||
lines.translation: First of all, the lotuses bloomed in the woods;

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਚੇ ਹੰਸਾ ਸਗਲੇ ਜਨਾਂ ॥
lines.transliteration: taa che ha(n)saa sagale janaa(n) ||
lines.translation: from them, all the swan-souls came into being.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕ੍ਰਿਸ੍ਨਾ ਤੇ ਜਾਨਊ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਚੰਤੀ ਨਾਚਨਾ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: krisnaa te jaanaoo har har naacha(n)tee naachanaa ||1||
lines.translation: Know that, through Krishna, the Lord, Har, Har, the dance of creation dances. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਹਿਲ ਪੁਰਸਾਬਿਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: pahil purasaabiraa ||
lines.translation: First of all, there was only the Primal Being.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਥੋਨ ਪੁਰਸਾਦਮਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: athon purasaadamaraa ||
lines.translation: From that Primal Being, Maya was produced.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਸਗਾ ਅਸ ਉਸਗਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: asagaa as usagaa ||
lines.translation: All that is, is His.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਬਾਗਰਾ ਨਾਚੈ ਪਿੰਧੀ ਮਹਿ ਸਾਗਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: har kaa baagaraa naachai pi(n)dhee mahi saagaraa ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: In this Garden of the Lord, we all dance, like water in the pots of the Persian wheel. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਚੰਤੀ ਗੋਪੀ ਜੰਨਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: naacha(n)tee gopee ja(n)naa ||
lines.translation: Women and men both dance.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਈਆ ਤੇ ਬੈਰੇ ਕੰਨਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: naeeaa te baire ka(n)naa ||
lines.translation: There is no other than the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਰਕੁ ਨ ਚਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: tarak na chaa ||
lines.translation: Don't dispute this,

lines.gurmukhi: ਭ੍ਰਮੀਆ ਚਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhrameeaa chaa ||
lines.translation: and don't doubt this.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੇਸਵਾ ਬਚਉਨੀ ਅਈਏ ਮਈਏ ਏਕ ਆਨ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: kesavaa bachaunee aeee maeee ek aan jeeu ||2||
lines.translation: The Lord says, "This creation and I are one and the same." ||2||
